android.desc:
The world’s most popular wellness app.
* Apps of the Year Winner - TIME magazine and Women's Health *
* More time is spent on Insight Timer than on all other wellbeing apps combined *
* Happiest App in the World - Tristan Harris *

The number 1 free meditation app. Guided meditations, sleep music tracks, yoga, Pilates, movement, and wellness practices led by top meditation and mindfulness experts, neuroscientists, psychologists, and wellness teachers from Stanford, Harvard, the University of Oxford, and more. Music tracks from world-renowned artists. Join millions learning to meditate on Insight Timer to help calm the mind, reduce anxiety, manage stress, improve overall wellness, stay active, and sleep deeply.

With 100+ new free guided meditations and sleep tracks added daily, Insight Timer also offers yoga, Pilates, movement, and wellness practices for both beginners and experienced practitioners. Explore meditation and movement practices to support your everyday wellness routine.

FREE FEATURES:

Thousands of guided meditations and mindfulness practices
Breathwork and breathing exercises for relaxation, focus, and stress relief
Select by time to find short meditations on the go and build a simple daily meditation habit
Thousands of music tracks and ambient sounds to calm the mind, focus, and relax
Customizable meditation Timer
Follow your favorite meditation and wellness teachers
Community groups and features
Stats and milestones for tracking your progress
Yoga, Pilates, stretching, and movement practices
Short meditation, yoga, and wellness practices for mornings, evenings, and moments throughout your day
Sleep meditations, white noise, and ambient sounds to help you sleep better

SLEEP FOR INSIGHT TIMER

Struggling with insomnia? Can't get a restful night's sleep? Want to learn how to sleep better? Insight Timer offers thousands of free music tracks, meditations, and stories to help you get a better night's sleep. Create the best environment for sleep and rest through meditation, mindfulness, and wellness practices — there's something for everyone.

Sleep for Insight Timer features:
* Sleep Music
* Soundscapes
* Bedtime tales
* Sleep Meditations
* Sleep mode for all music

Sleep for Insight Timer also offers meditation courses for sleep. Improve your relationship with rest and sleep through the night with a number of courses that teach you how to sleep effortlessly, overcome insomnia, redefine your approach to sleep,
